analysis: Trial completed successfully with pinned-host macro validation HR@10 of 0.6113: +0.0001 versus the immediate parent (0.6112), and −0.0162 versus the supplied best (0.6275). Category HR@10: Movies_and_TV 0.660, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.625, Electronics 0.450, CDs_and_Vinyl 0.710. Node-adaptive depth attention produced essentially unchanged aggregate performance; this result provides no evidence of a meaningful improvement over uniform depth averaging. It does not establish whether oversmoothing caused the earlier plateau. Allocated GPU time was 956.36 seconds.
code_summary: One independently trained graph recommender and one selected checkpoint per category. Replaced uniform LightGCN depth averaging with a shared Linear–tanh–Linear scorer over concatenated depth-zero and depth-k embeddings, followed by node-wise softmax and weighted aggregation. Zero-initialized final scoring weights preserve uniform aggregation initially. Retained gated causal-convolution history attention, tied item embeddings, item bias, supervised-edge masking, sampled-softmax training, and existing hyperparameters. Training and inference use identical depth aggregation; predictor reconstruction validates architecture metadata and strictly loads one checkpoint per category. Diagnostics check initialization equivalence, finite normalized weights, scorer gradients, isolated nodes, and serialization parity. No ensemble or separately fitted auxiliary scorer.
